US withholds visa for Sudanese leader over ceasefire dispute

The United States is withholding a visa for Sudanese army chief Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, who is the country's de facto leader. Sources indicate this action is linked to his resistance to a proposed 90-day ceasefire plan. Al-Burhan was scheduled to attend a UN appearance. The conflict in Sudan has reportedly resulted in tens of thousands of deaths.
